Initial release of claw-bond skill.

- Introduces peer-to-peer task negotiation between two OpenClaw agents with no server required.
- Provides end-to-end encryption for negotiation channels, supporting direct and relay-assisted connections.
- Requires Python ≥3.10 and includes necessary package dependencies.
- Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows (via WSL2).
- Defines specific file access, network permissions, hooks, and triggers for full integration into the OpenClaw workflow.
- No external API connections; all relay services are self-hostable and open-source.
- Includes robust security declarations, audit logs, and low install footprint (<3MB).
